verses.text: Ha ix yilan heb' anima Jesús, ix k'e t'a jun tzalan. Ix em k'ojan ta', haxo heb' sk'ayb'um ix k'och heb' t'ay.
Ix sk'ayb'an heb', ix yalan icha tik:
--Ha heb' snachajel yuj to manh wach'ok heb' t'a yichanh Dios, te wach' yik heb', yujto ayxo och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios aj satcha'anh.
Ha heb' skus yuj smul, te wach' yik heb', yujto ha Dios ol ak'an sniwanil sk'o'ol heb'.
Ha heb' emnakil syutej sb'a, te wach' yik heb', yujto ol yikej jun lugar heb' yalnakkan Dios.
Ha heb' te ay snib'ej stojolb'itan spensar, te wach' yik heb', yujto ol och Dios yet' heb', yik wach' icha chi' ol aj stojolb'i heb'.
Ha heb' tz'ok' sk'o'ol t'a heb' yetanima'il, te wach' yik heb', yujto tz'ok' pax sk'o'ol Dios t'a heb'.
Ha heb' malaj chukal t'a spensar, te wach' yik heb', yujto ol yil Dios heb'.
Ha heb' ak'um lajwok owal, te wach' yik heb', yujto ha Dios ol halan heb' yuninalok.
Ha heb' tz'ab'an sya'il yujto wach' syutej sb'a heb', te wach' yik heb', yujto ayoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios aj satcha'anh.
Ha exxo tik, tato wu'uj tzex b'ajji, tato ay tas tz'ak'ji'och t'a eyib'anh, te wach' eyiko'. Hanhejtona' tato wu'uj tz'ak'jikot juntzanh es t'a eyib'anh, te wach' eyiko'.
Tzex tzalaj wal sik'lab'il, yujto te niwan spak ol he cha t'a satcha'anh. Icha tz'aj yak'ji'och t'a eyib'anh tikne'ik, icha chi' ajnak och t'a yib'anh heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka'.

Icha atz'am atz'am, icha chi' heyaj t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. K'inalok a atz'am atz'am satel sk'achial, ¿tas to ol aj sk'achib'ixi? Manhxalaj tz'och atz'am. Tonhej syumji'el atz'am, slaj stek'nub'an heb' anima.
Icha sakil k'inal, icha chi' heyaj t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. K'inalok ay junok chonhab' t'a junok tzalan, max yal-laj ko k'ub'aneli.
Ayik skak'anoch sk'ak'al ko candil, ¿tom ha t'a yalanh junok kajón skak'kan ochi? Ma'ay, palta cha'anh skutejk'e'i, yik wach' syil heb' tz'och t'a yol pat chi'.

Icha yaj jun candil chi', icha chi' eyaji. Ch'oxekel sakil k'inal t'a heb' anima, syalelk'ochi, haton he wach' b'eyb'al tze ch'ox yil heb', yuj chi' ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'a ko Mam Dios ayek' t'a satcha'anh.
Manh he na'a to in ja wak' lajwok ley Moisés yet' juntzanh sk'ayb'ub'al heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka'. Manh yujok jun chi' in jawi, palta in jawi yik wach' ol elk'och tas syal jun ley chi'.

Wal yel swal t'ayex, yowalil ol elk'och masanil tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a jun ley chi'. Yakb'an ayto ek' jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik yet' satcha'anh, malaj wal jab'ok Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkan chi' ol satelok. Wach'chom a junok letra, ma junok punto, malaj wal junok tas ol satelok, masanto ol elk'och masanil tas tz'ib'yajkan t'ay.

Ay juntzanh cheknab'il t'a jun ley chi', ichato malaj wal yelk'ochi, palta yalnhej mach max k'anab'ajan smasanil, syalanpax t'a heb' anima to max sk'anab'ajej pax heb', tato ol k'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios t'a satcha'anh, wal yel malaj wal ol aj yelk'och heb' t'a skal heb' ayek' ta'. Palta a heb' sk'anab'ajan tas syal jun ley chi', syalanpax t'a heb' anima to sk'anab'ajej heb', ayik ol k'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios chi', yel ton wal te niwan ol aj yelk'och heb' t'a skal heb' ayek' ta'.

Ha heb' k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yet' heb' fariseo, ichato te tojol sb'eyb'al heb' t'a yichanh heb' anima, palta swal t'ayex, tato manh ek'okto swach'il he b'eyb'al chi' t'a heb', toton manh ton ol ex k'ochlaj t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.

Kab'nak tas alb'ilkan t'a heb' ko mam kicham t'a peka'. Xchi icha tik: Manh he mak'cham heb' eyetanima'il. Yalnhej mach smak'ancham junokxo anima, yowalil ol k'och t'a yichanh ley, haxo ta' ol ch'olb'itaj tas yaji, xchi.

Palta a in swal t'ayex, yalnhej mach junok schichonoch sk'o'ol t'a junok yetanima'il, ol ch'olb'itaj tas yaji. Yalnhej mach sb'uchwaj t'a junok yetanima'il, ol ch'olb'itaj yuj heb' sat yajal. Hanhejtona' yalnhej mach junok sb'ajan junok yetanima'il, ay smay sb'atkan t'a infierno t'a skal k'ak'.
Yuj chi', ayik tzex k'och yet' eyofrenda b'aj tzeyak' t'a Dios, tato tze nakoti to ay b'aj ix och he mul t'a junokxo anima,
kanokab' jun eyofrenda chi' b'ela. B'at he b'okan yaj yet'ok. Slajwi chi', tzex jaxi, tzeyak'an eyofrenda chi'.

K'inalok ay heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a eyib'anh, tzex yik'anb'at heb' t'a winh yajal, ayik wan to he b'at t'a yol b'e, tze b'o'ankan yaj yet' heb', yik wach' maxtzak b'at ex yak'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh yajal chi'. Yujto a winh yajal chi' tzex ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh polenkía. Haxo heb' winh tzex ak'anb'at preso.
Wal yel swal t'ayex, maxtzak ex aktajeli masanto tze tup he multa smasanil.
Kab'nak pax tas alb'ilkan t'a sley Dios, ayik yalannakkani: Manh ex em ajmulal, xchi.
Palta a in tik swal t'ayex, yalnhej mach syiloch sk'o'ol t'a junok ix ix, a jun chi' toxo ix em ajmulal yet' ix t'a spensar.

K'inalok ayex, yuj yol he sat ay t'a he wach', tz'ixtaxel he pensar. Tato icha chi', wach' hama tzeyik'elta jun yol he sat chi', tzeyumaneli. Yujto wach' tato jab'nhej he niwanil satkaneli, t'a yichanh tzex b'atkan t'a infierno yet' he niwanil chi' smasanil.

K'inalok ayex yuj he k'ab' ay t'a he wach' tz'ixtaxel he pensar. Tato icha chi', te wach' tato tze tzepel jun he k'ab' chi', tzeyumankaneli. Yujto wach' tato jab'nhej he niwanil satkaneli, t'a yichanh tzex b'atkan t'a infierno yet' he niwanil chi' smasanil.
Atax t'a peka' alb'ilkan jun tik: Ha winh spuk sb'a yet' ix yetb'eyum, yowalil sb'okan junok yumal ayik spukan sb'a heb' chi', syak'ankan winh t'a ix, xchi.

Palta a in tik, swal t'ayex, tato ay mach spuk sb'a yet' ix yetb'eyum, tato manh yujok ajmulal, tato icha chi', a winh tz'ak'anoch ix t'a ajmulal. Hanhejtona', yalnhej mach junok winh tz'ik'an jun ix spuknak sb'a yet' winh yetb'eyum, tz'ochpax winh ajmulal.
Kab'nak tas alb'ilkan t'a heb' ko mam kicham t'a peka', xchi icha tik: Tato tze lok sb'i Dios Kajal, tzeyak'an he ti', yowalil tze k'anab'ajej juntzanh tas tzeyalkan chi', xchi.
Palta a in tik swal t'ayex, mokab'a junok tas tze lok sb'i. Max yal he lokan sb'i satcha'anh, yujto a jun chi', haton sdespacho Dios.
Yet' pax sat lu'um tik, max yal he lokan sb'i, yujto icha stek'nub' Dios yaji. Yet' pax Jerusalén, max yal he lokan sb'i, yujto a jun chi', haton schonhab' jun ko Reyal te niwan yelk'ochi.
Hanhejtona' he jolom, max yal he lokan pax sb'i, yujto manh eyikok he ch'okoj, yujto max yal eyak'an sakb'ok junok pitanh xil he jolom ma eyak'anxi k'ik'b'ok.
Ayik tzex loloni, Yel toni, xe chinhej, Maay, xe chi. Max yal he lokan sb'i junok tasi, yujto a jun lokoj b'i chi' t'a winh diablo skoti.
Kab'nak tas alb'ilkan t'a peka'. Xchi icha tik: Tato ay junok mach smak'an poj yol sat junokxo, mak'jokab' pax poj yiko'. Hanhejtona' tato ay mach smak'anel ye junok, mak'jokab' pax el yiko', xchi.
Palta a in tik, swal t'ayex, manh eyak' owal yet' heb' chuk syutej sb'a t'ayex. Tato ay junok mach st'ob'anb'at he ti' t'a he wach', tze meltzitejb'at junxo pak'anh t'ay.
Tato ay mach snib'ej stok'anek' he kamix t'a yichanh ley, tzeyak'paxb'at he chumpa t'ay.
Hanhejtona', tato ay junok mach tzex ak'an pural he kuchanb'at nanhalok legua yikatz, tato icha chi', jun legua tze kuchb'at t'ay.
Yalnhej mach junok sk'anan smajnej junok tas t'ayex, manh ex b'at miknaj t'ay.
Kab'nak tas alb'ilkan t'a peka'. Xchi icha tik: Tze xajanej heb' wach' eyak'an yet'ok. Haxo heb' eyajk'o'ol, schichonoch he k'o'ol t'a heb', xchi.
Palta a in tik swal t'ayex: Yowalil tze xajanej heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'ayex. Tzex lesalwipax yuj heb' tz'ak'anoch junok chukal t'a eyib'anh.

Icha chi' tzeyutej he ch'oxanel he b'a to yel yuninal ex ko Mam ay t'a satcha'anh, yujto a tz'ak'anemta yok k'u t'a yib'anh heb' chuk yet' t'a yib'anh heb' wach'. Hanhejtona', syak'anpax emta nhab' t'a yib'anh heb' manh tojolok spensar yet' t'a yib'anh heb' tojol spensar.
Tato anhej heb' tzex xajanan tze xajanej, ¿tom ol he cha spak jun chi' tze na'a? Ina heb' winh tekumel tumin, hanheja' icha pax chi' syutej sb'a heb' winh.
Hanhejtona', tato anhej heb' he wach' k'o'ol tze k'umej, ¿tom ay yelk'och jun chi' he na'ani? Ina heb' manh ojtannakok Dios, hanheja' icha pax chi' syutej sb'a heb'.
Yowalil tz'akan ex t'a masanil tas wach', icha ko Mam ayek' t'a satcha'anh, tz'akan t'a masanil tas wach'.
